scientific_choices.choice: Paper sections 3.3 and 3.5 crop localized regions for recognition and name PARSeq-S; detector-generated boxes are an external experiment.
Use the qualified official PARSeq artifact and source archive already used by the crop experiments. Preserve the same frozen Total-Text TEST care annotations and normalized text/bbox matching.

Recognize every stored YOLO box directly, with zero added padding and no PARSeq confidence, mask, grouping, or empty-reading filter. Read each low-score box once and evaluate the three predeclared YOLO score controls.

Execution device is explicitly selected at launch. CPU FP32 execution, when selected, and batch size 32 differ from the paper environment; record device, threads, batch size and CUDA memory where applicable.
The qualified PARSeq checkpoint is not established as the paper's PARSeq-S artifact. Local bbox Hmean is not the official polygon spotting protocol.
